description: DONE (folded 2026-07-03 as 7282de68c, three-lane audited PASS/PASS/PASS). THE LAST KNOWN PUSH IN COMPILER2 IS ELIMINATED — converted to pull correct-by-construction. World::stash_function_source's manual work_graph.enqueue(Job::PublishFunctionSource) is DELETED. Root: stash mutated pending_function_sources (raw state, not a FactKey) and PublishFunctionSource recorded ZERO reads on success, so nothing rewoke it on redefinition — the enqueue was the only rewake path. FIX: new FactKey::FunctionSourceStash(FunctionId) — a revision-only co-output signal (no demand_fact_producer arm, exactly like ModuleIndexed/ProtocolDispatch; the co-output doc comment lists it). PendingFunctionSourceMap::stash returns changed:bool (from source_same, a full structural comparison); every stashing site (ScopeSession::define_source_function, publish_protocol_surface) pushes FunctionSourceStash to outputs unconditionally + to changed ONLY when the source actually changed. publish_function_source_job now READS FunctionSourceStash on success (standing redefinition subscription) AND WAITS on it in the not-yet-scoped branch (fixes a SECOND blind spot the enqueue also papered over: a vacuous-conclude for functions whose owning code hasn't arrived yet). Now the ordinary changed-revision-wake drives all rewakes — no job enqueues another job. AUDIT-VERIFIED: (northstar) push genuinely gone, no enqueue-in-disguise; every deleted-enqueue case (redefinition, protocol republication, first-arrival) mutation-proven now covered by the fact-wake — reverting the reads line reproduces the stale-frontier failure, reverting the waits line reproduces a real first-arrival deadlock; the arm-less-co-output wait resolves for late-arriving code and only stays blocked for genuinely-absent functions (Scheduler::complete writes co-outputs before the wake loop, no race). (work-minimalism) PublishFunctionSource fire count IDENTICAL parent-vs-commit across 5 fixtures + 3 redefinition scenarios (14 fires on 00001 both sides; redefine-main 14->16 both; byte-identical-resubmit 14->18 both) — no under/over-fire; FunctionSourceStash bumps changed ONLY on real source change (zero spurious churn). (removable) declared/handled exactly like existing co-output facts, nothing stranded, the two-part read+wait subscription proven non-redundant by deletion. 1166/0/24; rg follow_up zero production. The scheduler's work-start reasons are now: changed-revision wakes, the demand_fact_producer arm map (pull-on-stall), standing root+activation-frontier demands, blocked-waiter expansion, and the 2 sanctioned ignitions (submit_root + bounded product-pulls). NO unsanctioned pushes remain.
title: stash_function_source manually enqueues PublishFunctionSource — a push bypassing the fact->producer map
